record.question: Which of the following statements about Suspension of Government servant under Rule 10 of the CCS(CCA) Rules 1965 is correct?
options: A Government servant cannot be placed under suspension for more than 365 days under any circumstances.
A Government servant may be placed under suspension where, in the opinion of the competent authority, he has engaged himself in activities prejudicial to the interest of the security of the State.
An order of suspension made under the Rule may at any time be modified or revoked by the Chief Minister of state.
A Government servant placed under suspension may be allowed to draw full pay during the period of suspension.
